Ask a question
01How do I book a room?+

Message us on WhatsApp with your dates and number of guests. Our team will confirm availability, your room options and the current rate before you book.

02Where is Tozak Hotel?+

You’ll find us at Plot 25/27 Ekiugbo/Warri Road, Ekiugbo, Ughelli, Delta State, Nigeria. Open the map below for directions.

03Is breakfast included?+

Breakfast is available. Please ask our team whether it is included in your chosen room rate, and confirm serving times when booking.

04What time can I check in or check out?+

Please confirm check-in and checkout times with our team before arrival. If you need an early arrival or a late departure, include it in your enquiry.

05What is the cancellation policy?+

Ask our team for the terms that apply to your booking, including deposits, payment and cancellation, before confirming your stay.

06Can I ask about a longer stay?+

Of course. Send us your preferred dates and any special requests so we can discuss the room options with you.

Booking information

A few details
before you arrive.

Our team will confirm availability, your room rate, what’s included, and any payment or cancellation terms before you complete your booking.

Please check arrival and departure times, ID requirements and any special requests with us. Sending an enquiry does not reserve a room until the hotel confirms your booking.

We use the details you share to respond to your enquiry. This form prepares a WhatsApp message; no enquiry is stored on this website.
